title: Create a Theme From an HTML Template | Orchard Core
description:
A static HTML template is a finished design, but it has no way to manage its content. A theme keeps the design and lets Orchard Core supply the pages, the menu, and the widgets.

This video turns a template into a theme the way the built-in TheBlogTheme was made from the Clean Blog template: static assets in the wwwroot folder, named resources, a Liquid layout with zones, content templates, and an optional setup recipe.

In this video:
• From template to theme: what you start with and what you build
• Copy the assets
• Declare the resources
• Build the layout
• Zones: where widgets appear in the layout
• Template the content
• A setup recipe
• Use the theme
